source: Exact marked full symmetric quotient family

source: Diagonal normalizers and finite quotient classification
where: First two proof paragraphs in D_symmetric_completion.tex
evidence: Repeated kernels are compared by the induced automorphism, with explicit deletion/reinsertion maps. The normalizer of a diagonal simple block inside the alternating product is that block. source: D40 source action, exact common sign quotient and compatible conjugators
evidence: The iterated-coordinate-kernel proof excludes all S_n quotients of U. Its exact common quotient with the simultaneous symmetric image is C2. The actual Bab-zero conjugators pair with identity coordinates; the single profinite gauge and Fhat-prime commutator are retained. The two projection kernels are computed directly in the full fibre product.

The projective generators exhaust336 elements and their even-source restriction exhausts168. All six simple-group conjugacy classes and their normal closures are checked, as is the trivial centralizer and faithful degree8 action. Both complete paired images are enumerated under the displayed source maps, with orders56448 and28224.

The finite coordinate-kernel argument excludes PGL2(F7) as a quotient of the all-perfect/all-symmetric source image. Its actual source-kernel image is nontrivial, lies in the simple derived subgroup, and therefore equals PSL2(F7). The canonical mod7 quotient is simultaneously killed by this kernel, giving an exact comparison of the two markings.
